svg.aria-label: The demo's Record with shadows: after the host writes, ShadowMaps::Record fits each cascade into ShadowData and, between two barriers, draws a depth-only pass from the sun into one layer of the shadow map per cascade. In the scene pass, Mesh.frag.glsl samples the map at set 0 binding 4 and dims only the sun's light.
